parameters.name: AgentId
parameters.description: The Agent ID used for the service. You can specify an Agent generated after enabling DAS Agent or an Agent that you manually created. If not specified, the default Agent is used.

parameters.name: SessionId
parameters.description: The session ID in UUID string format. If not specified, a new session is created by default. To maintain context across conversations, use the same session ID.

parameters.name: Summary
parameters.description: Specifies whether to output summary information.
